name: Rules of Engagement: Newlyweds
source:
One year after your magical summer, you throw a housewarming party to reconnect with your family! Will you plan a reunion to remember?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rules_of_Engagement:_Newlyweds]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
神奇的夏天过去一年后，你举办了一场乔迁派对，与家人重新联系！你会计划一次难忘的聚会吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Rules_of_Engagement:_Newlyweds]Choices Wikia[/url]]
